module_summary: Serial-to-parallel converter: a 4-bit bit counter gates an 8-bit shift register; after 8 valid bits the word is loaded to the output with a one-cycle valid pulse.

anchors.name: sh
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register assembling serial input bits

anchors.name: k
anchors.why: Bit counter 0..8 tracking received bits; reset when din_valid drops

anchors.name: din_serial
anchors.why: Serial input bit shifted into sh

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Input valid qualifying shifting and counting

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: Parallel output word loaded from sh on wrap

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle valid pulse when a full byte is loaded

anchors.name: wrap
anchors.why: Count==8 terminal flag: loads output, raises valid, clears counter

anchors.name: take
anchors.why: Shift enable: din_valid while counter below 8

anchors.name: sh_mirror
anchors.why: Redundant duplicate shift register with no fanout

groups.name: Bit counter
groups.description: Counts valid bits to 8 and flags word completion

groups.name: Shift register
groups.description: Shifts serial bits into 8-bit word when take asserted

groups.name: Output register
groups.description: Latches completed word and pulses dout_valid
